One- and two-suit deals come from a certified catalog verified solvable. Four-suit deals are not yet certified.
Build eight runs from King down to Ace, each in a single suit. A finished run is banked and leaves the board. Clear all eight and you win.

Any face-up card can move onto a card one rank higher, whatever its suit. Several cards move together only when they already run down in order and share a suit. An empty column accepts anything, which makes it the most valuable thing on the board.

Tapping the stock deals one card face up onto every column at once — there is no waste pile and nothing to draw one card at a time. It refuses while any column is empty, so fill the gap before dealing.
One suit is the gentlest game, four the hardest; two sits between them and is the default. The count is fixed when a game is dealt — change it in Settings and it applies to the next new game.

Tap a card to send it to the next legal column on its right, wrapping around; tap again to keep walking it along. Drag to choose a column yourself. Hint lights the top card of every run that has somewhere to go. When only the last run is left, the game finishes it for you.
